results: 1. Slit-lamp examination of the right eye to assess for iris heterochromia

pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
2. Measurement of pupillary latency in darkness versus light (dilation lag)

pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
3. Topical instillation of 0.5% apraclonidine into both eyes
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Congenital Horner syndrome (due to congenital sympathetic denervation)
Alternative 1: Congenital oculomotor nerve palsy with aberrant regeneration
Alternative 2: Physiologic anisocoria with congenital ptosis
